 MidLE RESULTS: November 2026 Midwives Licensure Exam List of Passers
 Board Exams PH ,
 November 11, 2026 ,
 1 Comment 
 MANILA, PHILIPPINES — The Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) announces that 1,343 out of 2,632 passed the Midwives Licensure Examination given by the Board of Midwifery in 18 testing centers all over the Philippines this November 2026.  
 The Board of Midwifery is composed of Hon. Melchor C. Dela Cruz, Jr., Chairman; Hon. Lerma M. Valenzuela, Hon. Corazon F. Landicho, Hon. Lourdes S. Mangahas and Hon. Maria Teresa C. Padilla, Members.
